source: PTCS 6 championship format announcement (pasted by L.J., 2026-09-03)
note: All events Best of 9, cards 1920-1989, Variants on. Times are FIRST SIM, ET. Value bands for Live and Cap were announced as tier words ('High Iron Floor-Low Gold Ceiling'); the numeric MIN/<= clauses translate them onto the value scale in constants.ts. MIN 50 for 'High Iron' is inferred from the Iron band (40-59) and is the one number to confirm.
